import sys, json, time, numpy as np
from lib2 import train, forward, SX
from synth import dataset
ts = int(sys.argv[1]); n = 80000
X, nz, c, Xd, cd = dataset(ts, n, w1=1.5, hidden=32)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0); perm = rng.permutation(n); val = perm[:8000]; tr = perm[8000:]
base = dict(hidden=256, lr=0.003, batch_size=128, warmup_frac=0.02, weight_decay=0.3)
def softmax(z):
    z = z - z.max(1, keepdims=True); e = np.exp(z); return e / e.sum(1, keepdims=True)
probs = {}
for wd in [0.1, 0.3, 1.0]:
    for seed in [0, 1, 2]:
        t0 = time.time()
        P, norm, L, _ = train(X[tr], nz[tr], 20000 * len(tr) // n, dict(base, weight_decay=wd), seed=seed)
        pv = softmax(forward(P, norm(X[val]), L)[0]); pd = softmax(forward(P, norm(Xd), L)[0])
        probs[(wd, seed)] = (pv, pd)
        print("ts", ts, "wd", wd, "seed", seed, "noisyval %.4f clean %.4f  %.0fs" % ((pv.argmax(1) == nz[val]).mean(), (pd.argmax(1) == cd).mean(), time.time() - t0), flush=True)
for wd in [0.1, 0.3, 1.0]:
    pv = sum(probs[(wd, s)][0] for s in range(3)); pd = sum(probs[(wd, s)][1] for s in range(3))
    print("ts", ts, "ENS3 wd", wd, "noisyval %.4f clean %.4f" % ((pv.argmax(1) == nz[val]).mean(), (pd.argmax(1) == cd).mean()))
pv = sum(probs[(wd, 0)][0] for wd in [0.1, 0.3, 1.0]); pd = sum(probs[(wd, 0)][1] for wd in [0.1, 0.3, 1.0])
print("ts", ts, "ENS3 mixed-wd noisyval %.4f clean %.4f" % ((pv.argmax(1) == nz[val]).mean(), (pd.argmax(1) == cd).mean()))
EOF

echo started

# real sample: sweep wd at n=4000 for 32 passes with the sample's own 12.5% noisy hold-out as the selector
import json, sys, numpy as np
from lib2 import train, forward, SX, Sy, DX, Dy
res = {}
for wd in [0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0]:
    for seed in [0, 1]:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); perm = rng.permutation(4000); val = perm[:500]; tr = perm[500:]
        cfg = dict(hidden=256, lr=0.003, batch_size=128, warmup_frac=0.02, weight_decay=wd)
        P, norm, L, _ = train(SX[tr], Sy[tr], 32 * len(tr) // 128, cfg, seed=seed)
        nv = (forward(P, norm(SX[val]), L)[0].argmax(1) == Sy[val]).mean(); dv = (forward(P, norm(DX), L)[0].argmax(1) == Dy).mean()
        res.setdefault(wd, []).append((nv, dv))
for wd, v in res.items():
    print("wd", wd, "noisyval %.3f dev %.3f" % tuple(np.mean(v, 0)))
